strength.name: Barbell Back Squat
strength.description: Squat with the bar resting on the upper traps, giving an upright torso and heavy quadriceps emphasis.

strength.name: Barbell Back Squat
strength.description: Squat with the bar across the rear delts, leaning the torso forward to load the hips more.

strength.name: Front Squat
strength.description: Squat with the bar racked on the front shoulders, demanding an upright torso and strong quadriceps.

strength.name: Goblet Squat
strength.description: Squat while holding a dumbbell or kettlebell at the chest. A good entry point for learning squat mechanics.

strength.name: Leg Press
strength.description: Press a weighted sled away with the legs while seated, loading the legs with little demand on the back.

strength.name: Hack Squat
strength.description: Machine squat with the back supported against an angled pad, isolating the quadriceps.

strength.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
strength.description: Single-leg squat with the rear foot elevated on a bench, building leg strength and balance.

strength.name: Walking Lunge
strength.description: Alternating forward lunges that travel across the floor while holding dumbbells.

strength.name: Romanian Deadlift
strength.description: Hip hinge with nearly straight legs that lowers the bar to mid-shin, stretching and loading the hamstrings.

strength.name: Leg Extension
strength.description: Seated machine movement that straightens the knees to isolate the quadriceps.

strength.name: Lying Leg Curl
strength.description: Face-down machine movement that bends the knees against resistance to isolate the hamstrings.

strength.name: Seated Leg Curl
strength.description: Seated machine curl that isolates the hamstrings with the hips held in a flexed position.

strength.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
strength.description: Drive the hips up with the upper back on a bench and a barbell across the lap, targeting the glutes.

strength.name: Standing Calf Raise
strength.description: Rise onto the toes with the knees straight under load to build the calf muscles.

strength.name: Seated Calf Raise
strength.description: Calf raise with bent knees, which shifts more work to the soleus muscle under the main calf.

strength.name: Calf Press
strength.description: Push the platform away with the balls of the feet on a leg press machine, working the calves.

strength.name: Hip Abduction
strength.description: Seated machine movement that pushes the thighs outward to work the outer hips.

strength.name: Deadlift
strength.description: Lift a barbell from the floor to standing with the feet hip-width apart. A full-body pulling movement.

strength.name: Barbell Row
strength.description: Pull a barbell to the lower ribs from a hinged position to build the back.

strength.name: Pull-Up
strength.description: Hang from a bar and pull the chin over it with palms facing away.

strength.name: Chin-Up
strength.description: Pull-up with palms facing you, which brings the biceps in more.

strength.name: Lat Pulldown
strength.description: Pull a cable bar down to the upper chest while seated. A scalable alternative to the pull-up.

strength.name: Seated Cable Row
strength.description: Pull a cable handle to the midsection while seated, squeezing the shoulder blades together.

strength.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
strength.description: Row a dumbbell to the hip with one hand braced on a bench, training each side of the back separately.

strength.name: Face Pull
strength.description: Pull a rope attachment toward the face with elbows high, strengthening the rear shoulders and upper back.

strength.name: Barbell Shrug
strength.description: Raise the shoulders toward the ears while holding a loaded barbell to build the upper traps.

strength.name: Barbell Bench Press
strength.description: Press a barbell from the chest while lying on a flat bench. A staple upper-body strength lift.

strength.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
strength.description: Bench press with dumbbells, allowing a longer range of motion and independent arm work.

strength.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
strength.description: Press dumbbells on an inclined bench to emphasize the upper chest.

strength.name: Dip
strength.description: Lower and press the body between parallel bars while leaning forward to bias the chest.

strength.name: Cable Fly
strength.description: Bring the hands together in an arc using cables, keeping tension on the chest throughout.

strength.name: Push-Up
strength.description: Lower and press the body from the floor with a rigid plank position.

strength.name: Overhead Press
strength.description: Press a barbell from the shoulders to overhead while standing.

strength.name: Lateral Raise
strength.description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height to build shoulder width.

strength.name: Reverse Fly
strength.description: Raise dumbbells out to the sides from a hinged position to target the rear shoulders.

strength.name: Biceps Curl
strength.description: Curl a barbell from thigh level to the shoulders with the elbows fixed at the sides.

strength.name: Hammer Curl
strength.description: Curl dumbbells with palms facing each other, working the biceps and the forearm muscles beneath.

strength.name: Triceps Pushdown
strength.description: Press a cable attachment down by extending the elbows to isolate the triceps.

strength.name: Overhead Triceps Extension
strength.description: Extend the elbows with a dumbbell held behind the head, stretching the long head of the triceps.

strength.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
strength.description: Bench press with hands shoulder-width apart, shifting the load toward the triceps.

strength.name: Plank
strength.description: Hold a rigid straight-body position on the forearms and toes to build core endurance.

strength.name: Hanging Leg Raise
strength.description: Hang from a bar and lift the legs to hip height or higher, working the lower abdominals.

strength.name: Cable Crunch
strength.description: Kneel and curl the torso downward against a cable's resistance to load the abdominals.

strength.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
strength.description: Roll a wheel forward and back while keeping the core tight, challenging the abdominals and lower back.

cardio.name: Treadmill Running
cardio.description: Run on a treadmill at a steady pace or interval training.

cardio.name: Treadmill Walking
cardio.description: Walk on a treadmill at a steady pace to improve cardiovascular health.

cardio.name: Stationary Cycling
cardio.description: Pedal on a stationary bike for cardiovascular endurance.

cardio.name: Rowing Machine
cardio.description: Simulate rowing with a machine to work the entire body and improve cardiovascular fitness.
